title: Generic connectors
for: one server that reaches many apps: the long tail of tools with no vendor MCP, and one-off write actions

manual.export: A generic connector holds no data of its own; export from the bridged tool per its own category.
manual.drop: no data of its own; the bridged category's manual route applies

vendors.name: Zapier MCP
capabilities: actions picked per app in the Zapier UI
OAuth to each app handled by Zapier
caveats: Exposes whatever actions the connected apps allow, including sends and posts; deny the whole server (`mcp__zapier`) by default and allow named tools per workflow.
One MCP tool call costs 2 Zapier tasks from the shared pool: Free is 100 tasks a month (about 50 calls); Pro from $19.99 a month on annual billing (750 tasks).
The endpoint is issued per user and embeds a secret, so the whole URL lives in the environment (ZAPIER_MCP_URL), never in a committed file.
Best catch-all for long-tail write actions; a poor fit for bulk reads.

auth.where: Zapier > MCP > your server URL (treat the URL as a key)

vendors.name: Composio (Rube)
capabilities: 500+ apps as tools through the hosted Rube server
OAuth to each app handled in the Composio UI
caveats: Exposes whatever actions the connected apps allow, including sends and posts; deny the whole server (`mcp__composio`) by default and allow named tools per workflow.
Rube is free in beta; Composio repriced in August 2026 to $29 a month for 50K calls, overage $4 per 1K. Pricing is volatile, check before committing a workflow to it.
Developer-oriented; the Rube endpoint URL is from the product site, confirm it on first connection.

auth.where: browser grant on first use; app connections in the Composio UI

vendors.name: Pipedream MCP
capabilities: OAuth to each app handled in Pipedream Connect
caveats: Exposes whatever actions the connected app allows, including sends and posts; deny the whole server (`mcp__pipedream`) by default and allow named tools per workflow.
Free for personal use with 100 credits a month; Basic $29, Advanced $49, Connect $99 a month.
Servers are per app and per user under mcp.pipedream.net, and the URL carries the account binding; keep it in PIPEDREAM_MCP_URL, one entry per app you wire.

auth.where: Pipedream > MCP > the app's server URL for your account (treat the URL as a key)

vendors.name: Make
capabilities: your on-demand Make scenarios exposed as tools
caveats: A tool is whatever the scenario does, so a scenario that sends or posts is a write; deny the whole server (`mcp__make`) by default and allow named scenarios per workflow.
Only scenarios you build appear; billed as Make operations on your plan.
The npm package is @makehq/mcp-server (the repo is integromat/make-mcp-server); pinned to 0.5.0 (checked 2026-09-04). Make also offers a cloud MCP endpoint per team, over SSE, not listed here.

auth.where: Make > Profile > API access (key); MAKE_ZONE is the host such as eu1.make.com; MAKE_TEAM the team id

vendors.name: n8n
capabilities: your n8n workflows exposed as tools through the MCP Server Trigger node
caveats: A tool is whatever the workflow does; deny the whole server (`mcp__n8n`) by default and allow named tools per workflow.
Self-hosted or n8n Cloud plan; the endpoint is per instance and per trigger, so N8N_MCP_URL holds it and the trigger's bearer credential goes in N8N_MCP_TOKEN.
n8n's own MCP for building workflows, and the community `n8n-mcp` npm package, are development tools, not this route.

auth.where: n8n > the MCP Server Trigger node > Production URL and its Bearer credential

vendors.name: Merge.dev, Nango, Paragon ActionKit, Unified.to
capabilities: unified integration APIs with MCP fronts, priced per connected account
caveats: Exposes whatever the connected app allows; deny by default if one is ever wired.

Priced per connected account, $50 to $750 a month at entry; built for SaaS vendors embedding integrations, overkill for one marketing team. Listed so the option is known, not recommended; no entry is given.
